div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-involvement-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: The substantive content of the resource was generated by an AI system.
An AI system supported a human author, while the human remained responsible for creating the substantive content.
An AI system transformed or reported existing information without independently asserting its clinical validity.
An AI system asserted clinical or factual content as an output of its processing.

description.value: Codes indicating the manner in which an AI system contributed to the content represented by a FHIR resource.
